listen_addresses.description: Which IP addresses/ hostnames the server listens on. Use '*' for all interfaces.

port.description: The TCP port the PostgreSQL server listens on.

max_connections.description: Maximum number of concurrent connections allowed.

shared_buffers.description: Amount of memory dedicated to caching data (e.g., '256MB', '1GB'). Recommended ~25% of total RAM for dedicated DB servers.

work_mem.description: Memory per operation (e.g., sort, hash) before spilling to disk. Higher values speed complex queries but multiply with connections.

maintenance_work_mem.description: Maximum memory for maintenance operations (VACUUM, CREATE INDEX, etc.).

wal_buffers.description: Shared memory for WAL writes. Set to -1 for automatic tuning.

wal_level.description: WAL level: 'minimal' (no replicas), 'replica' (basic replication), or 'logical' (logical replication & logical decoding).

max_wal_size.description: Maximum size of WAL files before a forced checkpoint.

min_wal_size.description: Minimum size of WAL files to retain after cleanup.

checkpoint_completion_target.description: Fraction of checkpoint interval over which WAL writes are spread (0.0–1.0). Higher = smoother I/O.

autovacuum_max_workers.description: Maximum number of autovacuum worker processes.

autovacuum_vacuum_threshold.description: Minimum tuple updates before vacuum is triggered.

autovacuum_analyze_threshold.description: Minimum tuple updates before analyze is triggered.

autovacuum_vacuum_scale_factor.description: Fraction of table size added to vacuum threshold.

autovacuum_analyze_scale_factor.description: Fraction of table size added to analyze threshold.

logging_collector.description: Enable logging to files (instead of stderr).

log_directory.description: Directory for log files (relative to data_directory or absolute path).

log_filename.description: Pattern for log filenames (supports strftime placeholders).

log_rotation_age.description: Max age of a log file before rotation (e.g., '1d', '24h').

log_rotation_size.description: Max size of a log file (in bytes) before rotation. 0 = unlimited.

log_min_duration_statement.description: Log statements slower than this (ms). -1 disables. Use 1000 to log queries >1s.

log_line_prefix.description: Prefix for each log line. Format codes: %m=timestamp, %p=pid, %u=user, %d=db, etc.

data_directory.description: Absolute path to the database cluster data directory.

hba_file.description: Absolute path to the client authentication config file (pg_hba.conf).

ident_file.description: Absolute path to the user name mapping file (pg_ident.conf).

items.description: Name of an extension to preload at server startup (e.g., 'pg_stat_statements', 'timescaledb', 'auto_explain').

shared_preload_libraries.description: List of shared libraries to load at server start (extensions requiring init).
